authority: Live repository files and commit history are authoritative. This digest is a compact handover, not a substitute for reading them.

defer: New diagrams until comparison findings stabilise

Implementation and security claims unsupported by evidence
invariants: Image carriage is a required research comparison, not a mandatory runtime route.
Orchestration is optional; model service roles separately.
Protected object remains invariant unless explicit authenticated conversion is defined.
No anonymity/security inference from carrier uniqueness, concealment or extra hops.
Preserve dissent, provenance and historical work; distinguish proposal from demonstrated result.

document_boundaries.thesis_and_research: Substantive argument, technical principles, evidence, contribution assessment, uncertainty and limitations.
document_boundaries.operational_documents: Verified status, priorities, dependencies, blockers, paths and next actions; link to research files rather than duplicating thesis exposition.
document_boundaries.session_digests: Structured operational handover only; not thesis exposition.
document_boundaries.assistant_working_notes: Maintain the same separation; mention project status only when relevant.

checkpoint_protocol: At session start fetch live default branch and both digests; read PROJECT_STATE.md, WORKPLAN.md, WORK_LOG.md and relevant research/supporting documents.
Identify verified completions, unfinished tasks, blockers, dependencies and the next unblocked action; do not ask the user to repeat recorded history.
After meaningful progress update affected research/supporting documents and WORK_LOG.md; reconcile PROJECT_STATE.md.
Change WORKPLAN.md only when roadmap, priorities, dependencies or workflow genuinely change.
Read back and verify PROJECT_STATE.md, WORKPLAN.md and WORK_LOG.md.
Refresh SESSION_DIGEST.md from verified working documents; refresh SESSION_DIGEST.json last.
Read back both digests and verify agreement with the three working documents.
Record exact next action, relevant paths, blockers/dependencies and constraints.

document_roles.project/PROJECT_STATE.md: Changing verified progress snapshot; completed work, remaining tasks, blockers, dependencies and exact next action.
document_roles.project/WORKPLAN.md: Stable roadmap, research principles, priorities, sequencing and dependencies.

actions: Fetch the live default branch and both session digests.
Read PROJECT_STATE.md, WORKPLAN.md, WORK_LOG.md and relevant thesis, research and supporting documents.

Resume without asking the user to repeat project history.
Update affected records after meaningful progress and verify every GitHub write by fetching saved content.

diagram_policy.format: Genuine visual illustrations; never ASCII art.
diagram_policy.timing: Create or improve only when the underlying argument and evidence are stable; otherwise defer.

claim_discipline: Never claim saved, completed, published, deployed, tested or audited without evidence.
Distinguish drafted, committed, read-back verified, tested and independently reviewed.
